schema: source_manifest fields: source_id, url, revision, retrieved_at, sha256, license, coverage, status, usage, limits

sources.name: Gacha Revenue Tracker
sources.license: fan-made, non-commercial analytics view; figures are third-party estimates
sources.coverage: Zenless Zone Zero, 40 banners, game-i Japan per-banner estimate total ¥22.81B
sources.usage: 40-banner game-i JPY and Qimai China-iPhone USD per banner window, JP/CN best grossing rank; support vs main-C revenue ratios and the simulator revenue-structure benchmark
sources.limits: Japan mobile only; rebuilt from top-grossing ranks with day weights; excludes PC and the official payment-center top-up channel; double-UP banners share one window. Not a per-player spending truth.

sources.name: game-i (ゲーム・アプリ売上予測)
sources.coverage: Japan iOS/Google Play daily revenue estimate in yen, aggregated per banner by SRC_REVENUE_TRACKER
sources.usage: underlying basis of the 40-banner JPY series
sources.limits: rank below ~200 counted as zero by the aggregator; Japan only

sources.name: 七麦数据 Qimai
sources.coverage: China App Store (iPhone) daily grossing rank and USD estimate, surfaced as a layer of SRC_REVENUE_TRACKER
sources.usage: China iPhone daily revenue estimate summed per banner window and best top-grossing rank (via tracker data files)
sources.limits: iPhone only, China only, model estimate; on overlapping banner days the tracker splits the day by game-i proportions

sources.name: Sensor Tower app overview
sources.coverage: worldwide monthly mobile revenue; per-banner split in SRC_REVENUE_TRACKER is an apportionment
sources.limits: per-banner figures are not reported by the source

sources.name: rng.moe Zenless Zone Zero global signal statistics
sources.coverage: 26 limited agent banners and 26 W-Engine banners from 2024-07 to 2026-01 (statistics last updated 2026-01-30; later banners have no statistics while the tracker is in maintenance); standard channel 268,841 users
sources.usage: per-banner users and total pulls, 50/50 outcomes, 5-star chance by pull number; anchors the simulated pity curve, W-Engine/agent pull ratio and support/main pull demand
sources.limits: opt-in contributors are engaged players; pulls include free currency; no spending amounts

sources.name: StarDB ZZZ Signal Tracker
sources.coverage: personal imported signal history with per-banner pity counters
sources.usage: checked for global aggregates: the Signal Tracker shows only the signed-in user's imported history, so it provides no global statistics

sources.name: Fernández del Río, Guitart, Periáñez. A Time Series Approach To Player Churn and Conversion in Videogames. Intelligent Data Analysis 25(1):177–203, 2021 (arXiv:2003.10287)
sources.coverage: Age of Ishtaria (mobile freemium RPG), 2014-09-25 to 2017-05-09, ~2.1M players, 33,194 payers
sources.usage: behavior-model reference: login churn (9 days absent) and purchase churn (paying user with 50 days without purchase) are modelled as separate daily series with different event and calendar covariates
sources.limits: different game and market; supports the two-state structure, not any coefficient of this model

sources.name: Mustač, Bačić, Skorin-Kapov, Sužnjević. Predicting Player Churn of a Free-to-Play Mobile Video Game Using Supervised Machine Learning. Applied Sciences 12(6):2795, 2022
sources.coverage: four years of player records of a multiple-choice storytelling F2P mobile game
sources.usage: behavior-model reference for login churn as its own prediction target in F2P games
sources.limits: predicts player churn only; does not model purchase churn

sources.name: Lakić, Bernik, Čep. Addiction and Spending in Gacha Games. Information 14(7):399, 2023
sources.coverage: online survey of 713 gacha players (Reddit); 612 open answers on reasons for spending
sources.usage: spending motives: unlock a character/weapon 77.7%, skins 39.3%, progress faster 20.5%, competitive advantage 5.8%; 53.8% spent for a limited-time character or weapon — evidence on gap-driven (M0) vs novelty/collection-driven (M2) purchase structure
sources.limits: self-selected Reddit sample, self-report, mixed gacha titles; 'unlock a character' does not separate attachment from strength

sources.name: Mobile Game Retention & Churn Analysis (Kaggle, rajatsurana979)
sources.coverage: events.xlsx, 27,291 rows x 3 columns of daily user activity from an unnamed LiveOps mobile game
sources.limits: no spending fields, no game identity or collection provenance, D1/D7/D30 scale does not map to 42-day periods of an existing cohort; download requires a Kaggle account

sources.name: Figshare search for gacha spending / psychology survey data
sources.revision: queries: gacha; gacha spending; loot box spending survey; microtransaction survey
sources.coverage: returns supplementary PDFs of Frontiers in Psychiatry 2026 (adolescent gacha players and problem gambling), a Hong Kong problem-gambling article and loot-box correlation tables; no respondent-level gacha spending motive data
sources.limits: available items concern problem-gambling severity, not stop-paying vs quitting or purchase motives
